items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. In addition, define the exact conditional position probability q_y=volume.tilted(x↦−V(x)−‖x−y‖²/(2η)) and the initial phase probability ν_y=q_y⊗N(0,I_E). Both probability normalizations are conclusions derived from the same six analytic hypotheses. For each fixed y,xRef, each continuous real f:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 with |f(z)|≤M for all z, define the actual clock expectation A_t f(z)=∫_Ω f(Z(y,xRef,z,t,sample))P(dsample). For every finite t≥0, A_t f is Borel measurable in z; z↦(A_t f(z)−f(z))² is ν_y-integrable and obeys the pointwise bound (A_t f(z)−f(z))²≤4M² for every phase z. Moreover ∫(A_t f(z)−f(z))²ν_y(dz)→0 as t→0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter on nonnegative reals. The same single existential actual phase Z is used for every test, bound and initial state. These outputs hold for every deterministic y and xRef without any phase-invariance premise. This is the bounded continuous real test subclass, an attributed ASTIS extension of the authors compactly supported continuous test ingredient in AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. It is not the general L² equivalence-class operator theorem. Full invariant-law and AE-representative semantics, contraction/Jensen, C_c density and extension to every L² test, restart/Markov/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/unbounded cost, actual-input composition and full main results remain separate OPEN obligations.
assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, including dimension zero. V is real-valued and C²; α,β are nonnegative reals.
Exactly six analytic source hypotheses: α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative bound.

Standing E,V,α,β,η are fixed. y,xRef,z0,t,sample are arguments of one jointly Borel map. P and ε are literal canonical definitions; measurability, positive support, recurrence, cover and nonaccumulation are produced dependencies.

The deterministic covered-arc characterization and uncovered fallback hold for every sample. Actual all-time agreement and initialization hold on one AE sample event for each fixed parameter triple. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The initial-phase fallback is an explicitly labelled ASTIS measurable extension only on the uncovered complement; zero-time exceptional bounces need not have source index0 at t0.

The new probability estimates and zero-time stochastic continuity quantify each fixed y,xRef,z0. Every real δ>0 is allowed; t tends to zero within NNReal with its ordinary, nonpunctured neighborhood filter. The positive-threshold tail at zero is zero by retained AE initialization.
The phase-flow defect can occur only after the first event. Neither equality of the defect and first-event events nor a linear Ct estimate is claimed.

The same existential Z precedes every test f and every bound M. Tests are real-valued and continuous on the literal product phase; every M≥0 bounding |f| globally is quantified. This is an explicit ASTIS C_b elaboration of source C_c, not a new dynamics condition.

The integral is over the actual iid exponential clock law P for fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0. Boundedness gives integrability; no arbitrary law, probabilistic convergence, integral bound or expectation limit is a public premise.

For every deterministic y, q_y is the exact quadratic Gibbs tilt under volume and ν_y=q_y.prod(stdGaussian E). Their probability laws are derived internally from the original assumptions, not supplied as public normalization or invariance premises.

For fixed y,xRef and f,M, the new conclusions concern state measurability and outer square integrability/convergence under this exact ν_y. The clock input is the same independent canonical P; neither y nor xRef is randomized or substituted through a correlated law.

All-L2 equivalence-class well-definedness, invariant law, contraction and density are excluded. The bounded-test argument uses the finite probability ν_y and an explicit4M² integrable constant, not invariance or a TV transfer for unbounded quantities.
